anchor_after: Another connection leads back to [Prahallada Nataka](../prahallad-nataka.md). In 2018, Prateek Pattanaik documented performances with photographer Debendra Pattanayak and theatre artist Arjun Samantaray. Prateek credits Subhashish with lending a camera and advising on videography and production; community contributions helped fund the work.[^nataka-documentation] A camera, a performer, someone who knows the tradition, and people willing to help: this is one concrete way shared care can take shape.
addition: The collaborations extend into other films. O Foundation’s 2021 treatment credits Prateek as co-cinematographer of *Remosam*.[^remosam-credit] The released trailer of Shankhajeet De’s *Ramaleelas of Odisha* credits Prateek and Puloma Pal for additional script, research and subtitles.[^ramaleelas-credit]
